caption: The drawing depicts a single wall clock centered on a plain, light beige background. The clock has a round white face with black Roman numerals indicating the hours, and two black hands pointing to the time. The clock face is surrounded by a wooden circular frame, which transitions into a tall, narrow, tapered wooden case that widens into a square, box-like base with a decorative lower edge. At the very top of the clock, above the circular face, is a metallic or possibly brass-colored round ornament. The wood of the clock’s body is depicted in shades of reddish-brown, with some areas showing darker grain patterns for texture and depth. The overall composition is minimalistic, with the clock as the sole object, rendered with attention to detail and placed centrally on the page.
title: Wall Clock
